explanation: Try every next substring and recurse only when it equals its reverse. Copy the partial partition at each extension and record completed partitions in text order.
timeComplexity: O(n²·2^n) conservative worst case, including slicing and palindrome checks
spaceComplexity: O(n²) active slices/partial lists, plus output
